Following the [[Raid in the Rudrig system]], three [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] were hijacked by their [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 units]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] mounted an effort to recover the X-Wings and their pilots.<ref name="X-wing" />
